data = open('/tmp/seeds/testdata/soccer_cif_20f_q16_bd10.ivf','rb').read()

print('Magic:', data[:4])
print('Version:', int.from_bytes(data[4:6],'little'))
print('Header len:', int.from_bytes(data[6:8],'little'))
print('Codec:', data[8:12])
print('Width:', int.from_bytes(data[12:14],'little'))
print('Height:', int.from_bytes(data[14:16],'little'))
print('Framerate num:', int.from_bytes(data[16:20],'little'))
print('Framerate den:', int.from_bytes(data[20:24],'little'))
print('Num frames:', int.from_bytes(data[24:28],'little'))
# First frame header
frame_size = int.from_bytes(data[32:36],'little')
print('First frame size:', frame_size)
print('First frame timestamp:', int.from_bytes(data[36:44],'little'))
# First few OBU bytes
print('First frame bytes:', data[44:44+32].hex())
"
